slides.title: Arsi attacks: church gives new toll
slides.body: Update from Al Jazeera and Anadolu, Oct 27, 2026

slides.title: Orthodox Christians killed, church officials say
slides.body: In separate attacks on Oct 20 and Oct 24 in Arsi Zone. More than 20 seriously injured, 20 homes burned.

slides.title: killed on Oct 20 in Merti district
slides.body: In Gora Silingo, Angada Kebele, according to church officials.

slides.title: killed on Oct 24 in Shirka district
slides.body: In the villages of Tereta, Chole and Birbo, church officials said.

slides.title: Who is responsible is not established
slides.body: No group claimed the attacks. A local official reportedly blamed a new rebel alliance including the OLA; the OLA denies attacking civilians.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate independently.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Al Jazeera / Anadolu, Oct 27, 2026 (church officials)
